beschreibung: Official | Waldemar Anton withdraws from Germany squad, Ridle Baku earns late call-up – Jürgen Klopp has recalled RB Leipzig's Ridle Baku to the Germany squad following Waldemar Anton's withdrawal through injury.

Manuel Neuer expected to be sidelined for six weeks – At the age of 40 years and 225 days, Neuer became the oldest player ever to represent Bayern Munich in a Bundesliga match, surpassing the club’s previous record. \
